decision: Set up persistent memory system with /memory directory
reasoning: Need a way for the AI assistant to maintain context across sessions without re-explaining the project every time
expected_outcome: Faster onboarding at each session; consistent behavior and preferences respected

decision: Destructure hasPermission in Students.jsx to support accounts_manager role
reasoning: hasPermission was called in Students.jsx without being destructured from useApp() context causing ReferenceError crash
expected_outcome: Accounts manager and role-restricted users can load Students page safely

decision: Strict production DB protection policy on git deployment
reasoning: Live production database data must never be overwritten or seeded with demo data during pulls; only schema structures update
expected_outcome: Zero data loss for live student payments and user records during deployments

decision: Implement Certificate Generation & Management System with live preview and email PDF attachment
reasoning: Need official completion certificates customizable per course with partner logos (DEEP10X)
column9: and direct email delivery with zero manual overhead

decision: Fix 500 error on Direct Admission creation in studentController.js
reasoning: User email and customId duplicate checks were missing and customId was not passed to Student.create causing DB unique constraint crashes
expected_outcome: Direct admission creates students and user accounts cleanly with friendly 400 validation error responses instead of 500 crashes

decision: Enhance checkStudentExists to check User model & customId with live inline form warning
reasoning: checkStudentExists only checked Student table for email which allowed submitting duplicate User emails
expected_outcome: Forms show instant inline warnings on duplicate email/customId before submit and guide user to Existing Student Enrollment tab

decision: Increase core sync fetch timeout to 30s & add Socket.io HTTP polling fallback
reasoning: 6s timeout was too tight for cPanel shared hosting cold starts causing Core Sync Error and pure websocket was blocked on WSS
expected_outcome: Data loads reliably on cold starts and Socket.io connects seamlessly via polling fallback

decision: Automatically link existing User account when creating Student profile in studentController.js
reasoning: If an email exists in Users table but not in Students table createStudent links the existing User without throwing duplicate error
expected_outcome: Seamless student registration regardless of whether a User login account pre-existed in system

decision: Fix Certificate API 500 error & html2canvas oklch color parsing in PDF generator
reasoning: Batch model include used non-existent batchName/code causing 500 error and html2canvas crashed on CSS oklch color functions
expected_outcome: Certificates load cleanly and PDFs generate instantly without canvas rendering errors
